name: Auth: max deliveries in total per hour
description: Hard cap on ALL codes/calls the server sends within an hour, over every login, device and method. The per-login caps bound what one number receives; this one bounds the bill when the numbers are all different and the senders come from a proxy pool. Calibrate before enabling on production: take the busiest hour in the send ledger over a week and multiply by three — too low a value means nobody can sign in at peak. 0 = unlimited.
